notes.title: Play now: One Card One Shot - Mafia demo!
notes.content:
THE ONE CARD ONE SHOT - MAFIA DEMO IS AVAILABLE NOW!
We're thrilled (and a bit nervous) to announce: the demo for One Card One Shot – Mafia is now available to play on Steam!
Get ready to dive into a world where strategy, action, and explosive cards collide in intense battles against the mafia.

Available from April 30 to May 4.

TRY THE DEMO AT GAMESCOM LATAM TOO!
Swinging by Gamescom Latam? Don’t miss this: the demo will also be playable at the Xbox and Panorama Brasil booths!
This is your chance to test the game before everyone else — and even score a launch key. Don’t sleep on it!

IN ONE CARD ONE SHOT – MAFIA, YOU WILL:


 Build a badass deck with cards that deal damage, protect your skin, or throw creative (sometimes totally chaotic) twists into the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/5f47cb113308c27fb2fa2b2e428408f08ab4a377.gif

 Face enemies that never let up. They attack, defend, and make you rethink your choices… kind of like adult life.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/f7ca1689b1927b4c0d6d5fda4729906bdb0b6b6e.gif

 Use secondary weapons at just the right moment to turn the tide when all seems lost.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/9f8562f855965c07878ad026b0e43ede00e4f407.gif

 Watch out — enemies literally fall from the sky. No metaphor here. One minute it’s calm, the next you’re staring at airborne thugs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/a9faca228ebfb71c1049856d9e6b48c50090f72d.gif

 Think you’ve got everything under control… until the fireworks start. Dynamite flies in from all directions and you scramble to defuse them — just don’t shoot one by accident. (We tried. Wouldn’t recommend it.)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/7f9174bb890a682aa0ca542d59819428160cfaab.gif

 Tackle fast-paced mechanics in both 3D and top-down shooter styles — because the heat comes from every direction here.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/53d5d62a1b9a8663778528ca032bd8ce4de862bf.gif


We truly appreciate your support — thank you!
This project is built with tons of passion (and probably too much caffeine), and having the community with us means everything.

Send us your feedback, your ideas, and even your most embarrassing defeats (we promise to laugh respectfully).
Join our Discord, follow us on social media, and wishlist the game on Steam so you don’t miss a thing!

Thanks so much — and good luck facing the mafia (you’re gonna need it). ♡

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332120/One_Card_One_Shot__Mafia/
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Rbwh_aQBJg

notes.title: Survivor Cells Update is Here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/1f69c8bd06a08832c78041f63b8cf868cbc56b65.png

Survivor Cells has just received a fantastic update! Get ready to explore all the new features and take your gaming experience to the next level!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/7b2b7db2ffb2784f934334bc9ec7ab5131c748e9.gif

- New Game Mode: Endless  
Now you can test your limits in the new Endless mode! Survive as long as possible against endless waves of enemies in a never-ending gameplay experience. Start the mode already at Year 100 with upgrades purchased in the laboratory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/fc38ae8490b7bc7e1233db916cedded37b50ef42.gif

- Alchemy Improvements  
The Alchemy system has been refined, making strategy creation even more dynamic. Adjusting your build during gameplay is now more intuitive and effective!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/ad3a7fe3179e7392b551be77af6dec16efa4cb1d.gif

- Laboratory Enhancements  
The Laboratory has been updated to make managing your cells and resources easier, making your decisions more strategic and practical.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/e34e423cf05c1842f9a60f3254041c405ed764bb.gif

- Various Fixes and Gameplay & Navigation Improvements  
We’ve implemented numerous fixes and improvements that make gameplay and navigation smoother and more engaging, ensuring a more enjoyable experience.

- New SFX  
To further enhance your immersion, we've added new sound effects that will make your battles even more exciting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/16cfe50711f9e65f590827764194d75799503578.gif

Update your game now and enjoy all these improvements!  
Get ready to face new challenges and take your survival to the next level!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1976100/Survivor_Cells/

notes.title: Next Update! - News and Information!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/8d71c20dc00d20ab98f1aee31ab2a5a40677ae51.png

Hello, Everyone!

We are incredibly excited to announce that Survivor Cells is about to receive its first major update, scheduled for January 30th. Get ready for a true feast of improvements, adjustments, and innovations that will take your gaming experience to a whole new level!

In our constant quest for perfection, we will be resetting the ranks to implement crucial fixes and enhance the ranking system. This will ensure an even fairer and more balanced competitive environment for all players.

And the good news doesn't stop there! To celebrate this incredible milestone with the 1st Major Update, we are offering a special discount throughout this week. It's the perfect opportunity to join the adventure if you haven't already and secure the free DLC!

Mark your calendars:
-> January 30th!
Don't miss out on these exciting updates that will elevate your Survivor Cells experience to a new level.

Remember that we highly value your feedback; it's invaluable to us. We appreciate you being part of the Survivor Cells community. Be ready for an exciting journey, and we'll see you in the cells! 🦠🔬

***The DLC will be free only during the Early Access period of the game, so be sure to download it to register it in your Steam account. After the official launch, it will be a paid DLC!

• Publish your island in the workshop
• The islands that will participate in the event must be made from 07/08/22 to 07/18/22.
• Only ONE ISLAND per user will be accepted! If the participant has more than one island uploaded with #Creative, we will analyze the date posted, the one that was uploaded last is the one that will participate and the others are disregarded.

notes.content:
Hey guys!

We are very happy with our game and would like to thank all players for the Feedbacks and Reviews!!!

Suggestions and reviews are very important to us!!!

Today we are happy to release a new update with improvements to the game and the new “Game Modes” section in it you will find “Speed Run – Find the Tower”.

To access the “Game Modes” section you must complete the adventure mode.

Update

+ Improved particle system;
+ New “Game Modes” section;
+ New mini game “Speed Run – Find The Tower”;
+ Exclusive ranking for “Speed Run – Find The Tower”;
+ Game optimization;

Speed Run – Find the Tower:

In gratitude for the community feedback and in celebration of the 2nd game in the series, the Geometric Sniper Blood in Paris, which will be officially launched on 09/09/21, we are launching the mini game “Speed Run – Find the Tower” which will have its exclusive ranking .

To score points you'll have to find 12 towers one in each level in the shortest time possible!

Who will be the fastest Sniper?


More news:

The third game in the series is already in production and you can now add it to Wishlist and see a video, images and gifs on the game page!
